evidence_limits: Evidence consists of user-provided Studio screenshots and the user-reported full contract address; no independent RPC or explorer verification was performed.
Successful state transitions are evidenced by Accepted-state reads. Their individual transaction IDs, execution receipts and finality were not supplied.
The two rejected attempts show FINALIZED / ERROR and Accepted consensus history. Acceptance and finalization do not mean successful execution.
The summary shown with the early cards rejection is timestamped 11:32, before the 11:33 error; it is not asserted to be a post-rejection read.
The deployed source, chain ID and deployment receipt were not independently verified. The recorded source SHA-256 belongs to the unchanged local file.
No complete get_plan output was supplied, so exact stored original rule text and per-rule evidence were not independently inspected. Rule text below records the instructed test inputs.
Two hosted interpretation outcomes are a bounded smoke check, not a live-model accuracy study, security audit or production-readiness finding.
The cards receipt displays two prerequisite hashes; the underlying wording/tables receipts were not separately fetched or cryptographically compared.
